title: Format USD micro-units as money with correct rounding

brief.goal: Add `formatUsdMicro(micro)` to src/money.ts rendering an integer number of micro-dollars as "USD d.dd": round half up to cents, always two decimals, a leading minus for negative amounts, and no floating-point arithmetic on the amount.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: a non-integer input throws a TypeError

expected_clean_output: Integer arithmetic with half-up rounding and two-decimal padding; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: Cents are truncated instead of rounded half up, so 1235000 renders as "USD 1.23".
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: formatUsdMicro(1235000) and formatUsdMicro(999999) are off by one cent.
